caseno: Appeal from Original Decree No. 139 of 1994.
lawyer: Khandker AM Mohsenuddin, Advocate -----For the Appellant.
parties:
Agrani Bank ------ Appellant
Vs.
AFM Enamul Haq ------ Respondent
full_judgment:
Mahmudul Amin Choudhury, J.: This appeal has been preferred against the judgment and decree passed by the learned Artha Rin Adalat and Subordinate Judge, Manikganj in Artha Rin Suit No. 34 of 1990. The trial Court dismissed the suit on contest. 

 3. The suit was filed before the learned subordinate Judge, Manikganj on 23-8-89 and it was registered as Money Suit No.12 of 1989 and it continued as such till 26-11-90. Thereafter on that date the learned Subordinate Judge converted the Money Suit into Artha Rin Adalat suit and registered it as Artha Rin Adalat Suit No. 34 of 1990 suo motu and then he disposed of the suit by dismissing the same. The plaintiff appellant on being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of dismissal of the suit preferred this appeal. 

 6. We have gone through the record and it appears that the plaintiff instituted the suit against their former employee who has allegedly misappropriated the bank money by showing disbursement in the names of certain fictitious persons and the suit was filed as a Money Suit. This was registered on 23-8-89 as such, and it continued as a money suit sill 25-11-90 and it further appears that on that date the learned Subordinate Judge abruptly converted the money suit into a suit under Artha Rin Adalat Ain and ordered for registering it as such and it was accordingly registered as Artha Rin Adalat Suit No. 34/90 although neither party prayed for such conversion. Artha Rin Adalat Ain is meant for realization of any loan advanced to any party by any financial institution including the present plaintiff-bank. Here the suit has been filed not for realization of any loan money from the defendant who was admittedly not a loanee, but that he misappropriated the bank's money. By no stretch of imagination the suit comes within the provision of Artha Rin Ain. It appears that the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellant's party before the trial Court has not brought the matter to the notice of thee Adalat, when the suit was converted at the fag end of the trial and the learned Advocate representing the defendant raised objection on the maintainability of the suit before the Adalat and the trial Court also appears while disposing of the suit to have accepted this contention. Instead of reconverting the same into a money suit the trial Court most illegally dismissed the suit on the ground of maintainability and thereby committed a gross illegality. The Adalat had no jurisdiction to try the suit as has been done in the present case. The suo motu conversion is also illegal. As a substantial amount of money is involved in the suit and as the case was illegally tried by the Adalat by suo motu converting the same from money suit to a Artha Rin Adalat suit we are inclined to set aside the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court and send the suit back on remand for fresh trial in accordance with law. 

 7. The proceeding from 26-11-96 before the Artha Rin Adalat till passing of the decree is no proceeding in the eye of law and, the Adalat assumes the jurisdiction not vested on it and the disposal of the suit by that Adalat has no legal consequence. 

 8. The appeal is hereby allowed without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree passed by the Arrha Rin Adalat in Artha Rin Suit No.34/90 of the Court of the Artha Rin Adalat and Subordinate Judge, Manikganj is hereby Set aside and sent back to the learned Subordinate Judge to try it as an ordinary money suit with notice to the both parties.
